Title: (LSJ) One more rules question that came up at the NJ Sabbat War prerelease

Messages.Author: Joshua Duffin
Messages.Body:
Forgot about this one before:

Is "Leave Torpor" different from "Rescue a Vampire from
Torpor"? This came up with regard to Mitchell the
Headhunter, whose card text says "Rescuing Mitchell
from torpor costs an additional blood."

Since they appear to be defined in the new rulebook as
two separate action types, we decided (after quite a bit
of thinking about it) that Mitchell's disadvantage only
applies when another vampire is rescuing him from torpor,
not when he is getting himself out. Is that correct?

Thanks,

Josh

there he goes, hunting heads again...

Sent via Deja.com http://www.deja.com/
Before you buy.
